## Github Publishing

There are maybe about 10-20% of students who still cant publish pages to GitHub.

There are two ways to publish to github.

1.  Pushing it from Rstudio/Positron. Its making an indexed HTML file that has a long folder name. Username.io/project/nameofhtmlfile.html

2.  Its different because it will help us perserve the same file name so that when you are pubished you have to stype the entire file name. One benefit of this is in teh fiolder you can have multipel html pages.

```         
1.  Using Terminal
2.  Using preview  + github repo settings.
```

sometimes index.html is simpler but sometimes its easier to do the other approach.

right now we are \_quarto.html which is is sort of a third method that is even more advanced. Thats the best way tbh.
